tools.name: calculate-postage
tools.description: Calculates Sri Lanka Post postage for a weight, in LKR. Without a destination it prices every local service (ordinary letter, open article, parcel, speed post, logi post). With a destination country it prices every international airmail and sea mail service, with optional extras such as registration

tools.name: calculate-cod-fee
tools.description: Calculates the Sri Lanka Post cash on delivery (COD) fee for a parcel: the Logi Post courier fee for its weight, the money order commission on the amount collected, and the flat service fee. All amounts are in LKR.

tools.name: find-post-office
tools.description: Finds Sri Lanka Post offices and postal codes. Search by post office name, 5-digit post code, short (tele) code, or a village or town name. Returns the post code, type, grade, whether it delivers, its division, phone numbers and, for a sub post office, the controlling post office. If no office match

tools.name: check-prohibited-articles
tools.description: Lists the items that are prohibited or restricted when posting from Sri Lanka to a destination country by international mail. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate-postage, find-post-office · Public sink: calculate-postage, calculate-cod-fee, find-post-office.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate-postage, find-post-office · Public sink: calculate-postage, calculate-cod-fee, find-post-office

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
